title: Self-avoiding walks on cubic graphs and local transformations
summary: Despite its elementary definition, the self-avoiding walk (SAW) poses notoriously hard enumerative problems: exact connective constants are known for only a handful of infinite graphs, notably the honeycomb lattice \cite{ds}. We establish a general substitution principle for SAWs on infinite connected quasi-transitive cubic graphs under port-transitive vertex replacements, where each degree-$3$ vertex is replaced by a fixed finite three-port gadget.
